summary: Gaa is a contemporary Indian fine-dining restaurant in a restored Thai house on Sukhumvit 53. Chef Garima Arora’s tasting menu reworks Indian techniques and flavours with seasonal Thai produce; it is a long, high-cost destination meal rather than a casual dinner.
whyGo: A distinctive Indian-led tasting menu rooted in Thai produce, in an intimate heritage-house setting.
A strong choice for a special occasion or for travellers interested in contemporary Indian cooking.
bestFor: Adventurous diners comfortable with a multi-course set menu and fine-dining prices.
A celebratory dinner; weekend lunch or afternoon tea for a shorter daytime visit.
skipIf: You want a quick, inexpensive, à-la-carte meal or need full control over each dish.
You have strict allergies or dietary needs that cannot be discussed and confirmed in advance.
duration: Allow about 2.5–3.5 hours for dinner as a planning estimate; the restaurant does not publish a set meal duration. Afternoon tea should take less time, but confirm when booking.
cost: The official site currently lists the signature tasting menu at THB 6,200++ per guest. For 19–31 December it lists a festive menu at THB 6,400++ for dinner and THB 5,200++ for lunch; these rates may change and the restaurant does not explicitly identify the year on the page. ‘++’ means service charge and tax are added, so budget above the listed amount. Pairings cost extra; confirm current prices.
hours: Dinner daily from 5:30 pm. Lunch and afternoon tea on weekends from 12 pm; the official site says afternoon tea is offered daily during its 19–31 December festive period. Reservations handled daily 11 am–6 pm. Confirm holiday service and your preferred seating time directly.
bestTime: Book the date and seating that suit your itinerary; weekend daytime service offers an alternative to the full dinner. December is peak travel season, so reserve early, especially for 19–31 December and celebratory dates.
gettingThere: At 46/1 Sukhumvit 53, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana. BTS Thong Lo is the nearest practical rail stop; a current local dining guide estimates about a 7-minute walk into Soi 53. A taxi or ride-hail can drop you at the address, but allow extra time for Sukhumvit traffic. Check the walking route and accessibility with the venue if needed.
booking: Book via the official site’s TableCheck link, or call +66 63 987 4747 / email the restaurant; the reservation line is listed as 11 am–6 pm daily. A valid credit card is required to hold a table. The stated free-cancellation window is more than 48 hours before the Gaa Experience and more than 24 hours before weekend afternoon tea; late cancellation, no-show or reducing party size may incur the full meal price per guest, excluding taxes. Mention allergies, vegetarian, vegan or gluten-free needs when booking; the restaurant says these options can be arranged with prior notice.
accessibility: The official site and Michelin listing reviewed do not describe step-free access, accessible toilets, lift access or seating accommodations. Contact the restaurant before booking to confirm the route through the heritage house and any specific mobility needs.
practicalTips: Treat listed prices as a base: tax and service charge are added, and drinks or pairings are extra.
Tell the restaurant about dietary requirements in advance; confirm they can safely accommodate any serious allergy.
Check the menu and holiday hours again before paying a deposit or travelling, as menus are subject to change.
decemberNotes: The official website currently advertises a 19–31 December festive menu (lunch THB 5,200++; dinner THB 6,400++) and daily afternoon tea at THB 1,900++ during that period. It does not specify a year, so verify that these terms apply to December 2026. No separate 2026 holiday closure notice was found. Expect higher demand around Christmas and New Year; Bangkok road traffic can lengthen the final approach.
uncertainties: The festive-menu date range appears on the live official site without a year; 2026 availability and pricing need direct confirmation.
The official page gives two different kids-menu prices: THB 2,500++ in the festive-menu note and THB 2,000++ in the children’s policy. Confirm the applicable price and age rules.
Exact meal duration, accessibility details, dietary cross-contamination procedures and current pairing prices are not published in the reviewed sources.
